scheme_name: Scheme Of Financial Assistance For The Preservation And Development Of Cultural Heritage Of The Himalayas
other_conditions: The voluntary organization must be registered as a society under the Societies Registration Act 1860 or as a public trust under the Indian Trust Act 1882
The organization must have been functioning for at least three years
The organization must have capacity, facilities, resources, and personnel to undertake and promote research projects related to the scheme
Colleges and universities are eligible only if they are affiliated with a university and introduce Himalayan art and culture topics into their curriculum or research courses
Grants will be given only to organizations not receiving grants from any other source for similar purposes
Preference is given to organizations that have good work in the field and can provide matching funds
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of up to ₹10 lakhs per organization for research, preservation, dissemination and training related to the cultural heritage of the Himalayas.
